capabilities: update the frontmatter title when a file is renamed
preserve custom titles that differ from the filename
add a title property on rename when none exists
configure which frontmatter key stores the title
extras: Installable via BRAT as a beta plugin; the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Renaming a file leaves its frontmatter title pointing at the old filename, so titles drift out of sync unless edited by hand.
summary: Rename helper that keeps the frontmatter title property in sync with a file's filename, leaving custom titles untouched.
